zh.title: 液压原理互动演示
zh.summary: 调整活塞和输入力，看一台小挖掘机如何举起重物。
zh.action: 拖动泵柄或调整输入力，观察输出力与挖掘机的变化。
zh.why: 手绘风格的三维装置把液压传力变成可以动手探索的场景。
zh.limit: 这是帮助理解原理的简化演示。

en.title: How Hydraulics Work
en.summary: Adjust the pistons and input force to lift a tiny excavator arm.
en.action: Drag the pump or adjust the input force and watch the output and excavator respond.
en.why: A hand-drawn 3D machine turns hydraulic force into something you can explore.
en.limit: This is a simplified demonstration of the underlying principles.

zh.title: Hearthlight：海边小镇冒险
zh.summary: 走进像素海边小镇，在温暖的世界里开启一段冒险。
zh.action: 在原站选择 Play，按游戏提示开始探索。
zh.why: 从海岸、灯塔到人物，像素世界充满细节。
zh.limit: 作者说明游戏仍可能有问题，完整流程尚未由 Freemy 试玩。

en.title: Hearthlight
en.summary: Step into a cozy pixel-art seaside village and begin an adventure.
en.action: Choose Play on the original site and follow the game’s prompts.
en.why: A detailed pixel world brings its coast, lighthouse and characters to life.
en.limit: The creator notes that the game may contain bugs; Freemy has not played through it.

verification.note: 已在桌面浏览器看到游戏标题画面；未完成游戏流程。
verification.note_en: The title screen was rendered in a desktop browser; the full game was not played through.

zh.title: Star Hop：星际跳跃
zh.summary: 驾驶小飞船在行星之间跳跃，看看你能飞多远。
zh.action: 点击开始，然后把握时机从一颗行星跃向下一颗。
zh.why: 一个容易上手的动作，搭配漂亮的星空与行星轨道。
zh.limit: 作者表示游戏仍在测试中；具体使用条件以原站为准。

en.title: Star Hop: Endless Galaxy
en.summary: Hop a little spaceship between planets and see how far you can fly.
en.action: Start the game, then time each jump from one planet to the next.
en.why: A simple action is paired with a vivid starfield and planetary orbits.
en.limit: The creator says the game is still in testing; see the original site for current conditions.

verification.note: 桌面浏览器已显示游戏画面，完整玩法尚未核验。
verification.note_en: The game screen rendered in a desktop browser; the full gameplay was not tested.

zh.title: Harmonograph：摆动绘图机
zh.summary: 调节摆的节奏和墨色，让一台复古绘图机画出精细曲线。
zh.action: 尝试切换频率比例或墨色，再按 Release pendulums 重新绘制。
zh.why: 把物理运动、音乐比例和生成艺术放进同一张纸上。
zh.limit: 作品来自作者的 AI 生成网页实验系列。

en.title: Harmonograph — A Drawing Machine
en.summary: Tune swinging pendulums and ink to draw intricate curves.
en.action: Change a frequency ratio or ink, then release the pendulums to draw again.
en.why: Physics, musical ratios and generative art meet on one sheet of paper.
en.limit: This piece is part of the creator’s AI-generated web experiments.

verification.note: 桌面浏览器已渲染绘图界面；尚未完成全部控件测试。
verification.note_en: The drawing interface rendered in a desktop browser; not every control was tested.

zh.title: Triple Pendulum Lab：三摆实验室
zh.summary: 拨动三节摆杆，看一条简单的轨迹如何变得不可预测。
zh.action: 抓住任意关节或摆锤，拖动后松手，观察轨迹与速度。
zh.why: 像坐进一间小小的物理实验室，亲手感受混沌运动。
zh.limit: 这是交互模拟，运动和性能取决于浏览器与设备。

en.title: Triple Pendulum Lab
en.summary: Give a three-link pendulum a push and watch its path become unpredictable.
en.action: Grab a joint or weight, move it and release to watch the trail and speed.
en.why: A small virtual physics lab makes chaotic motion tangible.
en.limit: This is an interactive simulation; performance varies by device and browser.

verification.note: Grok Bot 报告拖动关节后观察到速度、能量和轨迹变化。
verification.note_en: Grok Bot reported changes in speed, energy and trail after dragging a joint.

zh.title: Droste：无限房间
zh.summary: 走进画中画，体验一个不断向内延伸的彩色房间。
zh.action: 滚动改变缩放速度，或切换场景与递归效果。
zh.why: 一幅画里藏着另一间房，越看越远。
zh.limit: 这是视觉艺术实验，不是三维空间的真实漫游。

en.title: Droste — The Infinite Room
en.summary: Enter a picture within a picture in a room that keeps unfolding.
en.action: Scroll to change the zoom, or switch scenes and recursive effects.
en.why: A room inside a painting invites you to look further and further in.
en.limit: This is a visual art experiment, not a walkable 3D environment.

verification.note: 桌面浏览器已显示递归房间画面；尚未测试全部控制。
verification.note_en: The recursive room rendered in a desktop browser; not every control was tested.

zh.title: Light and Optics：光与光学
zh.summary: 走进三维放映室，跟随互动课程探索光的世界。
zh.action: 进入作品并选择一节课，跟随画面逐步探索。
zh.why: 将光学课程变成一场可以亲手参与的三维放映。
zh.limit: 作品需要图形加速，性能会随设备变化。

en.title: Light and Optics
en.summary: Step into a 3D projection room for an interactive journey through light.
en.action: Enter the experience, choose a lesson and follow it step by step.
en.why: Optics lessons become a 3D presentation you can explore yourself.
en.limit: The experience needs graphics acceleration and performance varies by device.

verification.note: Grok Bot 报告进入第一课并前进到下一步；设备图形性能会影响体验。
verification.note_en: Grok Bot reported entering the first lesson and advancing one step; graphics performance varies by device.

zh.title: Chroma：配色灵感工作室
zh.summary: 生成、调整和组合色彩，为下一个设计寻找灵感。
zh.action: 切换配色规则或点击 Generate，探索新的颜色组合。
zh.why: 把配色、色轮和预览放在一个清爽的工作台里。
zh.limit: 色彩与对比度结果请结合实际项目需求复核。

en.title: Chroma — Colour Palette Studio
en.summary: Generate, adjust and combine colors for your next design.
en.action: Switch the harmony rule or select Generate to explore another palette.
en.why: A clean workspace brings palettes, a color wheel and previews together.
en.limit: Check color and contrast results against your project’s needs.

verification.note: 桌面浏览器已显示配色工作台；尚未测试全部控件。
verification.note_en: The palette workspace rendered in a desktop browser; not every control was tested.

zh.title: Windtunnel：浏览器风洞
zh.summary: 把汽车放进虚拟风洞，观察气流绕过车身。
zh.action: 调整视角与风速，观察车辆周围的流场。
zh.why: 将空气动力学仪表和可视化风洞放进浏览器。
zh.limit: 图形负载较高；Grok Bot 的测试环境帧率较低。

en.title: Windtunnel
en.summary: Place a car in a virtual wind tunnel and observe airflow around it.
en.action: Adjust the view and wind speed to explore the flow around the vehicle.
en.why: A browser-based wind tunnel pairs aerodynamic controls with a live visualization.
en.limit: Graphics demands are high; Grok Bot reported a low frame rate in its test environment.

verification.note: Grok Bot 报告成功拖动相机，但测试环境约 1 FPS。
verification.note_en: Grok Bot reported moving the camera, at around 1 FPS in its test environment.
